help.title: Help
help.subtitle: How to use the app — short and simple.
help.worker_1: Open “Search” at the bottom, choose “I'm looking for a job”, then pick a profession and region.
help.worker_2: Open a matching listing: get in touch right away with “Call” or tap “Apply”.
help.worker_3: If you see “Application sent”, the employer has received it.
help.worker_4: On the home page tap “Post about myself” — employers will find you in search.
help.worker_5: Replies appear in “My account” → “My applications” and “Job offers”; updates in “Notifications”.
help.employer_1: On the home page tap “Post a job”.
help.employer_2: Choose the profession (not on the list? type it in), then fill in the region and terms step by step.
help.employer_3: Review the listing and tap “Publish listing”.
help.employer_4: In “My account”, the listing card shows the number of applications and “Matching workers”.
help.employer_5: Open an application: reply with “Shortlist” or “Reject”, get in touch via “Message” or “Call”.
help.safety_1: Never send money to anyone to get a job.
help.safety_2: Your phone number is visible only to employers you allow.
help.safety_3: See a suspicious listing or message? Tap “Report”.
help.report_hint: Every job and profile page has a “Report” button.

intro.s1_title: Finding a job is easy now
intro.s1_text: Browse jobs without signing up. Call the employer in one tap or send an application.
intro.s2_text: Post a job and candidates apply on their own. Find ready workers by profession and area.
intro.s3_text: We show jobs that fit your profession, area and expected pay. Type in plain words: “evening shift cashier in Chilanzar”.
